tools.name: list_my_rosters
tools.description: Lists the rosters saved to the signed-in Praetorium account. Requires mcp:read.

tools.name: get_my_roster
tools.description: Returns one roster owned by the signed-in player, by an id from list_my_rosters. summary names each unit with its points, models, wargear, enhancements, Warlord and attachments, and gives the total and any problems that stop the list being fielded; it is null while army data is unavailable. roster h

tools.name: list_my_battles
tools.description: Lists up to 25 battles with a cursor for the next page. Requires mcp:read.

tools.name: get_my_battle
tools.description: Returns the current seated view of a battle for the signed-in player. Requires mcp:read.

tools.name: save_roster
tools.description: Saves a complete roster. Pass its id to edit an owned roster; omit id to create one. limit is the battle size (1000, 2000 or 3000 points, or 600 for King of the Colosseum), which sets detachment points, enhancement and unit limits. pointsBudget optionally replaces only its points total (500 to 10000

tools.name: set_roster_visibility
tools.description: Changes the visibility of an owned roster. Requires mcp:write.

tools.name: create_battle
tools.description: Creates a battle with named player seats, using the same rules as the site. Requires mcp:write.

tools.name: submit_battle_action
tools.description: Appends a legal battle command only when expectedSeq matches the current log. Requires mcp:write.

tools.name: search_reference
tools.description: Searches Praetorium’s missions, rules, detachments, and datasheets by name, number, keyword, and value. Returns bounded excerpts with canonical URLs, source revisions, and attribution. Rules text is not included; records point to it upstream.

tools.name: get_reference
tools.description: Reads the complete bounded document returned by search_reference, with its revisions and attribution. A section that withholds rules text lists textSources: the pinned upstream file and record id to fetch if you need the wording.

tools.name: get_reference_record
tools.description: Returns the structured record behind a search result, including mission cards, deployments, terrain geometry, detachments, and datasheets. Records that withhold rules text carry textSources pointing at the pinned upstream file and record id.

tools.name: list_factions
tools.description: Lists the factions that can be used to narrow reference searches.

tools.name: list_reference
tools.description: Discovers available factions, mission packs, rule documents, reference kinds, and active source revisions.

tools.name: list_units
tools.description: Returns every pickable unit in one bounded response with unit-size costs, composition, attachment relationships, roster limits, roles, keywords, and links. Include a detachment, including one a chapter takes from its codex, to list only the units it allows and receive its rules, enhancements, upgrad

tools.name: simulate_combat
tools.description: Runs Praetorium's exact combat simulator for one attacking unit, with any attached leaders, against one defending unit at full strength: shooting, melee, and shooting followed by melee. Returns expected models destroyed, expected wounds lost, the chance to destroy the unit, cumulative odds, weapons

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_reference · Private data: search_reference, get_reference, get_reference_record, list_reference, list_units · Public sink: save_roster, submit_battle_action · Destructive: simulate_combat.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_reference · Private data: search_reference, get_reference, get_reference_record, list_reference, list_units · Public sink: save_roster, submit_battle_action · Destructive: simulate_combat

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_my_roster" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Returns the saved choices for one roster owned by the signed-in player. Requires mcp:read." → after: "Returns one roster owned by the signed-in player, by an id from list_my_rosters. summary names each unit with its points, models, wargear, enhancements, Warlord and attachments, and gives the total and any problems that stop the list being fielded; it is null while army data is unavailable. roster h"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
